授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: スマートシティの基本概念とそれに関連する複雑な社会問題を学び、データサイエンスの基本知識、IoTやスマートシティのためのデータ通信技術、スマートシティアプリケーションにおけるデータの生成、通信、解釈についての理解を深める。さらに、グループワークを通じて、スマートシティにおける複雑な社会問題に対する解決策を提案する。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students will learn the basic concepts of smart cities and their related complex social issues, acquire fundamental knowledge in data science, learn data communication technologies for the internet of things and smart cities, gain a deeper understanding of how data is generated, communicated, and interpreted in smart city applications. Additionally, they will propose solutions to complex social issues in smart cities through group work.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Smart City, Data Science, Communication, IoT, Issue based collaborative study, I-COIL,

・If first-year students participate, their programming knowledge should be checked in advance by the faculty member in charge.
・Every lecture would be conducted in English.
・Prior to taking this course, students who haven’t taken Programming Exercise classes should engage in self-study to familiarize themselves with the fundamentals of programming.
・Since this is an intensive Course, it is not possible to cancel the course in the middle of the course.
